title: 14 · Colophon ledger
summary: The index spine's last entry. The sitemap is set large as one ruled three-column table hung from the spine. The two doors are big contact lines aligned to the ledger columns: Request a System Audit ↗ over cols 4–9 and Talk to the team → over cols 10–12. The colophon follows as one footnote row under its own rule, and a quiet band holds the small lockup where the spine finally ends in its square. It reads like the closing index of an annual report instead of today's small-print link dump.

reference.borrowed: Until's calm editorial footer. Column labels are tiny mono uppercase, while the links under them are set large (≈24px) so the sitemap reads as a typographic statement, not small print. The contact column carries its line at the same confident size, and a quiet full-width band below holds only the small lockup at left with the copyright and minor links at right. It has very few words, lots of air, and no icons or boxes. Legora's 'Discover' contact block, small labels over large contact lines, supplies the two door lines.
reference.kelwin: It hangs from B's Index Spine: an opening rule from the spine with the 6px joint square, and '14 / COLOPHON' in the spine column (wide light 64px), with nothing else in cols 1–3. Until's columns become three column ledgers in cols 4–6 / 7–9 / 10–12. Each has a mono head and 24px normal-width rows with mono indices (C·01, F·01, R·01), and their hairlines run through the gutters, so the three read as one ruled table hung from the spine. The contact column becomes Kelwin's two doors at 32px on the same column axes, with no red, because B never sets red text and the red CTA panel sits just above. 'Request a System Audit ↗' (/audit, with audit@kelwin.co) spans cols 4–9, and 'Talk to the team →' (/contact, the live site's own contact wording, so it doesn't repeat the R·04 row above) sits in cols 10–12. The colophon is a single ledger row under a hairline: COLOPHON in col 4, the founding team's line in cols 5–9, and a 'Set in …' note in cols 10–12 that reads the typefaces actually in use, so it stays true in either skin. Until's bottom band becomes a 72px hairline row: the small real lockup sits in the spine column and the spine ends on that rule in its square. © 2026 Kelwin · Sister company of Plurel is at col 4, Privacy · Terms at col 10, and a London time readout is at the right margin. More than 45% of the stage is empty, with no giant lockup.

motion: entrance (≈2.5s, long durations, short distances): the opening rule draws from the spine to the margin (900ms) and the joint square appears. '14' fades (400ms), then the name. Column heads fade, then the twelve link rows reveal top-down: each rule draws left to right (600ms) as its text fades, at a 60ms stagger. The two door lines fade and rise 12px (700ms, 160ms apart). The colophon rule draws and its row fades. The band's rule draws, its contents fade, and the spine's end square appears last (400ms), so the page's index visibly ends.
ambient: none. The London readout updates its minutes and does not tick seconds.
interaction: a hovered row fills --panel through the gutters, its title shifts 8px right and its index brightens (300ms). The door lines grow an underline from the left and their arrows nudge.

on the live site: the sticky spine index crossfades (300ms) to 14 · Colophon as the footer enters, and the spine runs down from the CTA and stops at the band's square. prefers-reduced-motion shows the final state.
notes: Index 14 closes the spine numbering: the hero's foot reads '01 / 14', then reframe 02 … cta 13, footer 14 (the same section numbers A and C use, so mixed picks stay in order). The doors repeat two sitemap destinations on purpose — the two-door rule promoted out of the sitemap. Coherence pass: the opening rule now sits at the shared 128px; the spine label is the red-square caps label; sitemap titles take the 500 UI weight like every ledger title; the audit is indexed C·00 (the capability ledger's own zero, matching the nav), capabilities C·01–C·03; the door arrows are drawn SVG instead of font glyphs; mono at 11px / .18em.
